title: Father & Daughter, Easter Mobile Home Steps - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black and white snapshot with scalloped edges capturing a young girl dressed up in her Easter best sitting on a man's lap on the wooden steps of a mobile home or trailer. The photo date stamp on the right margin reads APR 61, coinciding with the handwritten red ink inscription on the back stating 'Easter Day - 1961'.
